Metadata.Integration: Copy each PolicyDocuments value into only the named new endpoint's PolicyDocument. Merge Parameters separately. This file is not a CloudFormation Mappings section or a standalone template.
Metadata.NetworkIntegration: Each endpoint SG admits only its corresponding worker/controller source SG on TCP 443. The Logs endpoint has both endpoint SGs; separate role/action/resource statements enforce its intended authorization split. S3Gateway has route-table associations and prefix-list egress, not endpoint SGs. Existing/default/shared endpoints and security groups must not be modified.

WildcardRationale.EcrAuthentication: GetAuthorizationToken uses Resource *; exact WorkerRole and __INSTALL_REGION__ conditions constrain this endpoint filter. Repository pull remains exact and repository push is absent.
WildcardRationale.SessionManager: The official minimal EC2 Session Manager policy uses Resource * for UpdateInstanceInformation and the four named channel actions. This proposal preserves that resource form with exact ControllerRole and __INSTALL_REGION__, without claiming instance/session resource restriction or a grant to start operator sessions.
WildcardRationale.S3Gateway: Gateway endpoint Principal * is required by its policy contract. Only GetObject for the regional ECR layer bucket is allowed. This is an endpoint filter, not a public bucket policy or new worker identity grant; no guessed execution-role condition is added to service-mediated image-layer requests.
WildcardRationale.Logs: ControllerLogGroup.Arn already contains the log-group :* IAM suffix and is used without appending another suffix. WorkerPlatformLogGroupArn must have no suffix; describe and stream-write suffixes are added separately. Wildcards stay under one exact group per role.

AcceptanceGates: Confirm VpcEndpointPolicySupported for each selected regional interface endpoint service before applying these fragments; ssmmessages support has not been independently observed. Unsupported or unverified filtering must block integration, not silently become default full access.

Verify service-mediated AgentCore ECR requests and log delivery present the proposed WorkerRole principal and requested-region context. The role-specific endpoint filter is proposed, not observed accepted; no service-principal or account-wide fallback is authorized.

Resolve exact WorkerPlatformLogGroupArn from the returned runtime ID and reviewed PILOT endpoint. Precreate/tag/retain the exact log group through the separately reviewed provisioning path. Generated-ID bootstrap and possible DEFAULT logging remain unresolved; this policy does not create log groups or grant runtime-prefix logging.

Use an already provisioned compatible EC2 SSM Agent using instance-profile SigV4 credentials and ssmmessages. Agent updates, patching, downloads, Run Command, State Manager and hybrid registration are not enabled. S3 is ECR-layer-only and does not cover SSM package buckets.

Operator StartSession and client-side channel access occur through a separately reviewed operator path. These SSM endpoint policies authorize only the controller node; they do not establish operator connectivity, transcript logging or optional KMS session encryption.

Observe effective role, repository, log, secret, key, organization and endpoint policies plus deployed denied-role/resource tests. Endpoint filters add restrictions; they do not replace identity policies or prove network isolation.

Ensure final resource ARNs and intrinsic references resolve only inside account __INSTALL_ACCOUNT__ and __INSTALL_REGION__; require Project=agent-controller on each new taggable endpoint and its separately reviewed resources.
No provider-secret read, provider egress or live-model invocation belongs to this synthetic stage. No resource creation or security change is authorized by these fragments.

WorkerPlatformLogGroupArn.Description: Exact approved and observed PILOT platform log-group ARN without :* or a stream suffix. Required after generated runtime ID is known; not a bootstrap workaround.
